blurb: The Links at Montague is a 9-hole executive golf course designed by Graham Cooke, featuring bentgrass tees, fairways, and greens, set in natural slopes and hardwood stands. They offer golf rounds, corporate tournaments, leagues, a driving range, and a golf academy with lessons and camps for all ages. The course includes practice facilities with a driving range and pitch and putt area, and hosts leagues and tournaments with buffet meal options.
